name: watcher
description: Multi-tenant AI-assisted Incident Logging, Verification & Offender Intelligence Platform

scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:auth && npm run build:incident && npm run build:verification && npm run build:frontend
scripts.docker:seed: docker-compose exec postgres psql -U watcher -d watcher -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/seed/01-seed-tenants.sql && docker-compose exec postgres psql -U watcher -d watcher -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/seed/02-seed-users.sql && docker-compose exec postgres psql -U watcher -d watcher -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/seed/03-seed-incidents.sql && docker-compose exec postgres psql -U watcher -d watcher -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/seed/04-seed-evidence.sql && docker-compose exec postgres psql -U watcher -d watcher -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/seed/05-seed-verification.sql
